jobs.title: סגול סאטן
jobs.description: קרוב לאייקון שאהבת, עם חומר חלק ומראה רך.
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Input image is the user's selected kettlebell app icon and is the shape and composition reference. Create ONE variant of this icon. Preserve a single upright centered kettlebell with a broad rounded handle, large clear handle opening, rounded body, compact base, and generous margins. Keep the same frontal camera and recognizable friendly silhouette. Square 1:1 full-bleed app icon artwork, no surrounding mockup, no rounded square container drawn inside the canvas. The kettlebell must be bold, legible at 48px, and stay within the central 72% of the square. No text, letters, numbers, logos, tiny details, extra objects or watermark. Variant: matte satin-clay lavender kettlebell (#9c85ff), no rough grain or speckled texture. Preserve the sculptural soft 3D style. Dark violet-black background #12111a with quiet purple halo, gentle upper-left lighting, subtle soft ground shadow. Rounded body and polished soft edges. High silhouette contrast.
